cases.title: SNAr of 4-fluoronitrobenzene with piperazine
cases.protocol: 4-Fluoronitrobenzene (1.00 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and piperazine (1.20 mmol, 1.2 equiv) were dissolved in DMF to give a substrate concentration of 0.30 M. The mixture was heated at 120 C under air for 6 h. Standard aqueous workup and purification gave the arylated piperazine product in 81% isolated yield.

cases.title: Knoevenagel condensation over N-doped carbon
cases.protocol: Benzaldehyde (5.0 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and malononitrile (5.0 mmol, 1.0 equiv) were combined with an N-doped carbon heterogeneous basic catalyst in acetonitrile. The suspension was heated at 50 C for 24 h in a 25 mL round-bottom flask. The 2-benzylidenemalononitrile product was obtained in 85% yield.

cases.title: Copper-catalyzed azide-alkyne cycloaddition
cases.protocol: An equimolar mixture of benzyl azide and phenylacetylene was prepared in acetone at 0.25 M with copper-in-charcoal (Cu/C, 10 mol%). The mixture was heated by microwave irradiation at 150 C for 3 min. The 1,4-substituted 1,2,3-triazole was isolated in 94% yield.

cases.title: Suzuki-Miyaura cross-coupling
cases.protocol: An aromatic bromide (1.6 mmol, 1.0 equiv), a phenylboronic acid derivative, base, and a palladium catalyst were combined in DMF. The mixture was irradiated in a 50 W microwave reactor at 50 C for 10 min. The biaryl product was obtained in 91% yield.

cases.title: Photocatalytic aerobic oxidation of Fmoc-L-methionine
cases.protocol: Fmoc-L-methionine (3.7 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole (10 mol%) were dissolved in acetonitrile at 0.10 M in a round-bottom flask. The solution was exposed to air and irradiated with a 1.5 W LED centered near 420 nm at 21 C for 5 min. Fmoc-methionine sulfoxide was formed in 99% yield.

cases.title: Photochemical benzylic bromination with NBS
cases.protocol: Methyl N,N-bis(tert-butoxycarbonyl)-L-phenylalaninate (1.0 equiv) and N-bromosuccinimide (2.0 equiv) were dissolved in carbon tetrachloride. The solution was irradiated with UV light at 30 C for 8 h. The corresponding beta-brominated product was obtained in 70% yield.

cases.title: Hydrogenolysis of N-diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol
cases.protocol: N-Diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol was dissolved in methanol and contacted with hydrogen over Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 at 60 C in a batch hydrogenation reactor for 5 h. Acetic acid may be used to enhance the reaction rate. The 3-azetidinol product was obtained in 38.1% yield.

cases.title: Palladium-catalyzed dioxygenation of alkenes
cases.protocol: An alkene (0.50 mmol, 1.0 equiv), PhI(OAc)2 (1.2 equiv), and a tridentate palladium complex immobilized on magnetic particles (3.5 mol%) were combined in DMF/AcOH (1:2) under nitrogen. The mixture was stirred at 20 C for 5 h to give the dioxygenated alkene in 86% yield.

cases.title: One-step dinitration of an aniline derivative
cases.protocol: An aniline derivative was treated with nitric acid in the industrial batch solvent at 60 C for 4 h. Nitric acid served as nitrating reagent and acid catalyst. The dinitrated product was obtained in 89% yield.

cases.title: tert-Butyl peroxypivalate synthesis
cases.protocol: Aqueous tert-butyl hydroperoxide was converted to potassium tert-butylperoxide with KOH (1.12 equiv), then reacted with pivaloyl chloride in the presence of sodium dodecyl sulfate. The biphasic exothermic reaction was run in a three-necked flask at 23 C for 31 min and afforded tert-butyl peroxypivalate in 53% yield.

cases.title: Two-step oxidative amidation of benzyl alcohol
cases.protocol: Benzyl alcohol and morpholine were used in a 1:1 ratio in dioxane at 0.667 M. TBHP was the oxidant, with NaBr and sulfuric acid promoting oxidation and amidation. The two-step batch sequence was operated at 80 C for a total of 30 min and afforded benzoyl morpholine in 76% yield.

cases.title: Multistep synthesis sequence toward dolutegravir
cases.protocol: The first operation of a seven-step sequence combined methyl 4-methoxyacetoacetate (2.0 mmol, 1.0 equiv) with dimethylformamide dimethylacetal (1.6 equiv) in acetic acid at 0.20 M. The batch operation was heated at 80 C for 60 min and furnished the vinylogous amide intermediate in 96% yield. The requested design objective is an integrated, staged continuous process through the reported dolutegravir sequence, with explicit residence time and additions for every stage.
